items.title_en: 40 Families, 1 Thief, Rs 1.2 Lakh In Shoes: Howrah's Bizarre Theft
items.summary_en: A thief broke into a Howrah housing society and stole shoes and slippers worth Rs 1.2 lakh from around 40 families. CCTV footage captures the theft., Kolkata News, Times Now
items.title_zh: 40 个家庭，1 个小偷，鞋子价值 12 万卢比：豪拉的离奇盗窃案
items.summary_zh: 一名小偷闯入豪拉住房协会，从约 40 个家庭偷走了价值 12 万卢比的鞋子和拖鞋。闭路电视录像捕捉到了盗窃事件。，加尔各答新闻，Times Now
